body: Confirmed via GitHub Actions API that commit 276614c passed every step including the Windows cross-compile. red-garden-build now contains RedGarden_Client (exe + SDL2.dll + PLAY.bat) and RedGarden_Server zips. Root causes fixed: outer #ifndef _WIN32 excluding all arena networking from Windows builds entirely, missing winsock includes, fcntl/close/getpid/mkdir POSIX-only calls. Found by locally reproducing the mingw cross-compile via apt-get download + dpkg-deb -x (no sudo needed), not by guessing blind. Commit 24bea48. BACKLOG S170-54.
title: CI green end-to-end: real Windows client artifact confirmed working
